justification: Both flag participant_id values in participants.tsv that do not match sub-<label>
The validator compares the subject folders with participant_id in both directions; neurolake splits the same comparison into two rules, one per direction
The other direction of the same comparison: a participants.tsv row whose subject has no data folder
Both flag a TSV row whose number of columns differs from the header
Both flag a JSON file that cannot be parsed
Both flag a fieldmap IntendedFor entry that points at a file not in the dataset
Both flag a dataset without dataset_description.json at its root
The validator's JSON schema for dataset_description.json requires Name and BIDSVersion, the two fields neurolake checks (only schema errors naming a missing required property in that file)
The validator's per-datatype JSON schemas (eeg, meg, ieeg, nirs...) list REQUIRED sidecar fields; only schema errors naming a missing required property count
RepetitionTime is a REQUIRED BOLD field in neurolake's seed (with VolumeTiming as the alternative)
TaskName is a REQUIRED BOLD field in neurolake's seed
Both flag a scans.tsv row naming a file that is not in the dataset
Both flag a RepetitionTime that looks like milliseconds; thresholds differ (validator above 100 s, neurolake 20 s or more)
Both flag a file whose content cannot be read
